plugins.name: aio-epub-translate
plugins.description: Translate EPUB books into literary Vietnamese end-to-end — upload, pre-translation analysis, chapter translation with consistency checks, quality review, and bilingual export.

skills.name: aio-epub-analyze
skills.description: Pre-translation analysis for EPUB books — analyze writing style, characters, tone, and build glossary before translating.
headings: 1. Lấy thông tin sách, TOC, và thống kê
Book stats — word count, chapter sizes
Chọn chapters mẫu: đầu, 1/3, giữa, 2/3, cuối
Dùng BatchGetPageJson để lấy tất cả mẫu trong 1 call
Xem guideline hiện có trước khi ghi đè
Nguyên tắc riêng cho sách này

skills.name: aio-epub-export
skills.description: Pack a translated EPUB into a downloadable file — bilingual (original + translation side-by-side) or translation-only output. Use when the user wants to export/xuất sách, đóng gói sách, generate an EPUB file, download a finished book, or send a translation to Kindle.

skills.name: aio-epub-manage
skills.description: Browse books, check translation progress, manage guidelines, view TOC, fork books, publish to community, reset chapters, and view usage stats.
headings: Workflow: get → chỉnh sửa items → save
Ví dụ: sửa title của chapter đầu tiên
Note: GenerateTOC trả về {"toc": ...}, khác với GetTableOfContent {"tableOfContent": ...}
Save bằng UpdateTableOfContent (same pattern as structured update above)

skills.name: aio-epub-quality
skills.description: Generate a translation quality report and surface chapters that need re-translation. Use when the user wants to check quality, kiểm tra chất lượng bản dịch, run QA, tìm bản dịch kém, find bad translations, or decide which chapters to retranslate before exporting.
headings: 2b. Literary Quality Evaluation (Đánh giá văn học sâu)
Filter only items with quality issues
Scan entire book (no filePath = all chapters)

skills.name: aio-epub-review
skills.description: Deep literary review of translated EPUB chapters — evaluate translation quality, fix consistency issues, and check cross-chapter coherence.

skills.description: Setup guide for EPUB translation service — register account, purchase license, and configure API key.

skills.name: aio-epub-translate
skills.description: Translate EPUB book chapters into literary Vietnamese with cross-chapter consistency (guideline + glossary + previous-chapter summary). Use when the user says dịch sách, dịch chương, dịch tiếp, continue translating, translate epub, or sends a book/chapter URL to translate.
headings: Lấy cross-chapter context (guideline + glossary + previous chapter summary)

skills.name: aio-epub-upload
skills.description: Upload an EPUB file and prepare it for chapter translation — extracts TOC, counts words, queues for analysis. Use when the user wants to add a new book, start translating an EPUB, tải sách lên, import a `.epub` file, or onboard a new title into the translation workspace.
headings: UploadEpub is streaming — use raw HTTP
PrepareBook cleans HTML, marks translatable content, generates guidelines
Check book exists and has content
